items.title: Howard Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2025
items.q: I mean with Trio Globo, Gene and Glen are very inspiring players and composers, and so that group is a very – it’s like a group of three equals and we all are inspired by each other and write things for each other.

ctx.x: These projects that you do, do you get the idea and then look for the people, or do you hear other musicians who inspire the idea?

Both. Definitely. I mean with Trio Globo, Gene and Glen are very inspiring players and composers, and so that group is a very – it’s like a group of three equals and we all are inspired by each other and write things for each other. And then sometimes I just, you know, write a tune and say, “Could you guys do this?” And sometimes they say no and
sometimes they say yes. And whenever they say yes it ends up sounding way better than anything I could have imagined.
